output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: The format of the output image

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: URL of the image to remove background from

output_mask.title: Output Mask
output_mask.description: Whether to output the mask used to remove the background

mask_only.title: Mask Only
mask_only.description: Whether to return only the segmentation mask without applying it to the image. When set to `True`, only the mask will be returned and foreground refinement will be skipped. Useful for reducing computation and data transfer when only the mask is needed.

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

model.title: Model
model.description:
Model to use for background removal.
            The 'General Use (Light)' model is the original model used in the BiRefNet repository.
            The 'General Use (Light 2K)' model is the original model used in the BiRefNet repository but trained with 2K images.
            The 'General Use (Heavy)' model is a slower but more accurate model.
            The 'Matting' model is a model trained specifically for matting images.
            The 'Portrait' model is a model trained specifically for portrait images.
            The 'General Use (Dynamic)' model supports dynamic resolutions from 256x256 to 2304x2304.
            The 'General Use (Light)' model is recommended for most use cases.

            The corresponding models are as follows:
            - 'General Use (Light)': BiRefNet
            - 'General Use (Light 2K)': BiRefNet_lite-2K
            - 'General Use (Heavy)': BiRefNet_lite
            - 'Matting': BiRefNet-matting
            - 'Portrait': BiRefNet-portrait
            - 'General Use (Dynamic)': BiRefNet_dynamic

operating_resolution.title: Operating Resolution
operating_resolution.description: The resolution to operate on. The higher the resolution, the more accurate the output will be for high res input images. The '2304x2304' option is only available for the 'General Use (Dynamic)' model.

refine_foreground.title: Refine Foreground
refine_foreground.description: Whether to refine the foreground using the estimated mask

image.description: Image with background removed. When `mask_only` is `True`, this contains the segmentation mask instead.
